segments.text:
Are not those mercies you expect from God
worth the waiting for? If not, it is your folly to
be troubled for the want of them: If they be,
why don't you continue waiting? Is it not all
that God expects from you for the mercies he bestows
upon you, that you wait upon him for
them? You know you have not deserved the least
of them at his hands. You expect them not as
a recompence, but a free favour, and if so, then
certainly the least you can do, is to wait upon
his pleasure for them.
